agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, May 02, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
A.
Public Safety & Traffic Commission Update
B.
Presentation Award - Certificate of Achievement for Excellence in Financial Reporting
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
Prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
Lomita City Council Meeting Agenda0May 2, 2017
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not in the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-d, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular meeting held on April 18, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Adopt Ordinance No. 787
ORD 787 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, AMENDING SECTION 11-1.15.02 (B) SECTION 11-1.49.04(2), SECTION 11-1.45.05(6), AND SECTION 11-1.66.03 TO DEFINE, PERMIT, AND SET PARKING STANDARDS FOR A "BREWPUB" WITHIN THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL (D-C) AND COMMERCIAL GENERAL (C-G) ZONE SUBJECT TO A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT AND DELETING SECTION 11-1.56.04 (CONSUMPTION) IN ITS ENTIRETY. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That the City Council Adopt Ordinance No. 787.
Item #7d
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
9.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE RELATED TO PERMITTING "CREDIT UNIONS" WITHIN THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL ZONE FOR REVIEW OF A PROPOSED CREDIT UNION AT 24520 NARBONNE AVENUE AND APPROVAL OF SITE PLAN NO. 1183
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ORD NO. 788 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA AMENDING SEC. 11-1.49.03(B) TO PERMIT "CREDIT UNIONS"
WITHIN THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL (D-C) ZONE SUBJECT TO A SITE PLAN REVIEW. (First Reading)
RES 2017-13 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA APPROVING SITE PLAN REVIEW NO. 1183 TO PERMIT A 2,678 SQUARE FOOT CREDIT UNION LOCATED AT 24520 NARBONNE AVENUE IN THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL (D-C) ZONE. (Initiated and Filed by South Bay Credit Union c/o Jennifer Oliver 312 N. Pacific Coast Highway, Redondo Beach, CA, 90277)
1)
Introduce first reading of an ordinance amending Section 11-1.49.03(B) to permit "Credit Unions" within the downtown commercial (D-C) Zone subject to a Site Plan Review; and
2)
Adopt a resolution approving Site Plan Review No. 1183 to permit a 2,678 square foot credit union located at 24520 Narbonne Ave., in the Downtown Commercial (D-C) Zone.
Item #9
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
10.
DROUGHT UPDATE AND CONSIDERATION OF DECLARING AN END TO DROUGHT RESPONSE LEVEL 1
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
RES 2017-14 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, DECLARING AN END TO WATER CONSERVATION DROUGHT RESPONSE LEVEL 1
ACTION: That the City Council declare an end to the current Drought Response Level 1, alert condition in the City of Lomita in accordance with Lomita Municipal Code (LMC) Section 12-4.01.08, and adopt said resolution.
Item #10
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING VESTING TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP NO. 71976 FOR A ONE LOT SUBDIVISION TO CREATE TWO LOTS EACH CONSISTING OF 9,573 SQUARE FEET LOCATED AT 25037 OAK STREET
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
RES 2017-12 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA APPROVING VESTING TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP NO. 71976 TO PERMIT THE SUBDIVISION OF ONE LOT TO CREATE TWO LOTS EACH CONSISTING OF 9,573 SQUARE FEET FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 25307 OAK STREET IN THE R-1, SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE. (Filed by Rick Gaunt, 2812 232nd Street, Torrance, CA, 90505)
ACTION: Staff recommends after conducting a public hearing, that the City Council approve the following:
1)
Adopt resolution approving Vesting Tentative Parcel Map No. 71976 to permit the subdivision of one lot to create two lots each consisting of 9,573 square feet for the property located at 25307 Oak Street in the R-1, Single Family Residential Zone.
Item #8
11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the next Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, May 16, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
